knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

## Read the raw data

Read from `../data/raw/`.

```{r reading in raw data}

# Load Baseball-Reference data
mlb_stats <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/raw/baseball_reference_raw.csv"
)

# Load MLB API data
hitting_raw <- readRDS(
  "../data/raw/mlb_api_hitting_raw.rds"
)

# Load ABS challenge data
abs_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  "../data/raw/abs_challenges_raw.csv"
)

# Load player height data
people_data <- readRDS(
  "../data/raw/mlb_people_raw.rds"
)
```
## Clean each source

## Cleaning and Transformation

The raw datasets contain different column names, formats, and levels of detail. The data was cleaned by standardizing column names, selecting relevant variables, creating consistent player identifiers, and preparing the datasets for merging.

The player name matching key was converted to lowercase and stripped of leading and trailing spaces to improve consistency across sources.

## Save the cleaned data

Write to `../data/processed/`.

```{r cleaning the MLB stats data}
mlb_clean <- mlb_stats |>
  dplyr::rename(
    player_name = Player,
    team_name = Team,
    games = G,
    plate_appearances = PA,
    at_bats = AB,
    hits = H,
    home_runs = HR,
    walks = BB,
    strikeouts = SO,
    avg = BA,
    obp = OBP,
    slg = SLG,
    ops = OPS
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player_name))
  )

head(mlb_clean)
names(mlb_clean)
```

```{r clean api data}
hitting_clean <- hitting_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = player$id,
    player_name = player$fullName,
    plate_appearances = stat$plateAppearances,
    avg = stat$avg,
    obp = stat$obp,
    slg = stat$slg,
    ops = stat$ops,
    home_runs = stat$homeRuns,
    walks = stat$baseOnBalls,
    strikeouts = stat$strikeOuts
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    player_name,
    plate_appearances,
    avg,
    obp,
    slg,
    ops,
    home_runs,
    walks,
    strikeouts,
    year
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id),
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player_name))
  )

head(hitting_clean)
```

```{r abs clean}
abs_clean <- abs_raw |>
  dplyr::select(
    entity_name,
    runs_above_average,
    runs_gained,
    runs_cost,
    n_challenges,
    n_overturns,
    n_confirms,
    rate_overturns,
    n_strikeouts_flip,
    n_walks_flip
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    player = entity_name,
    runs_above_avg = runs_above_average,
    challenges = n_challenges,
    challenge_wins = n_overturns,
    challenge_losses = n_confirms,
    win_percentage = rate_overturns,
    strikeouts_removed = n_strikeouts_flip,
    walks_gained = n_walks_flip
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_key = tolower(trimws(player))
  )

head(abs_clean)
```

```{r clean player height}
player_height <- people_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id = id,
    height_text = height
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    player_id = as.character(player_id),
    height_numbers = gsub("[^0-9]+", " ", height_text),
    height_numbers = trimws(height_numbers),
    height_parts = strsplit(height_numbers, " ")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    feet = sapply(height_parts, function(x) {
      if (length(x) >= 2) as.numeric(x[1]) else NA_real_
    }),
    inches = sapply(height_parts, function(x) {
      if (length(x) >= 2) as.numeric(x[2]) else NA_real_
    }),
    height_inches = feet * 12 + inches
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    player_id,
    height_text,
    height_inches
  )

head(player_height)
```

```{r}
mlb_clean <- mlb_clean |>
  dplyr::group_by(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```


```{r write cleaned data to processed}
readr::write_csv(
  mlb_clean,
  "../data/processed/mlb_clean.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  hitting_clean,
  "../data/processed/hitting_clean.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  abs_clean,
  "../data/processed/abs_clean.csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  player_height,
  "../data/processed/player_height.csv"

)
```
